findings.title: Worktree GC deletes the worktree of a running agent
findings.defect: `collect_stale` decides staleness from the mtime of the worktree root, which does not change when an agent writes only into nested directories.
findings.scenario: An agent edits `wt/bd-a1b2/src/**` for 31 minutes without touching the root → GC sees root mtime older than 30m → `remove_dir_all("wt/bd-a1b2")` runs under the live agent, uncommitted work is lost and the agent exits with `ENOENT`.
findings.fix: Before removal, read `.smetana/agent.lock` and skip the worktree if the holder PID is alive; fall back to mtime only when no lock exists.

findings.title: Write-lock is not released when the agent task panics
findings.defect: The lock is released by an explicit `unlock()` call at the end of `run_agent`, which is skipped on panic.
findings.scenario: The agent's tool call panics on a malformed diff → the task unwinds past `unlock()` → the task stays read-only until the app restarts.
findings.fix: Return a `LockGuard` from `lock()` and release in its `Drop` impl.

findings.title: Status hash differs between Rust and the UI for non-ASCII names
findings.defect: The UI runs FNV-1a over UTF-16 code units, while `status.rs` hashes UTF-8 bytes.
findings.scenario: A user status `"ревью"` → Rust slot `7`, UI slot `2` → the tray badge and the board column show the same status in two different colours.
findings.fix: Hash `new TextEncoder().encode(name)` in the UI and add a shared fixture of 15 names checked by both test suites.

findings.title: Migration fails when run a second time
findings.defect: The index is created without `IF NOT EXISTS`, and the migration is not recorded until after the statement succeeds.
findings.scenario: The app is killed between `CREATE INDEX` and the migration-table insert → next launch reruns the migration → `index idx_tasks_spawned_from already exists`, the store refuses to open.
findings.fix: Use `CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS` and wrap the statement and the migration record in one transaction.

lines: "CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_spawned_from ON tasks (spawned_from_id, relation_kind, updated_at) WHERE spawned_from_id IS NOT NULL AND relation_kind IN ('spawned-from', 'relates-to');",

findings.title: `gc.stale_after` setting is ignored
findings.defect: The threshold is hard-coded to 30 minutes instead of reading the config value.
findings.scenario: `stale_after = "2h"` in settings → worktrees are still collected after 30m.

findings.title: Toast shows the path with Debug quotes
Normalisation keeps a trailing dash
findings.defect: Runs of non-alphanumerics are collapsed before trimming, so edge dashes survive.
findings.fix: Strip leading and trailing `-` after collapsing.

findings.title: Reconnect backoff has no jitter
findings.scenario: Tracker restarts with 12 agents connected → 12 reconnects land in the same 10ms window on every step.

findings.title: GC test depends on wall-clock sleep
findings.defect: The test sleeps 2s and asserts on real mtimes.
findings.scenario: CI runner under load → mtime resolution and scheduling skew → intermittent failure.
findings.fix: Inject a clock and set mtimes with `filetime::set_file_mtime`.
